source_row.extraction_instructions: /Events 'View as List' is a plain table (<time datetime>, link to /Events/Event-Booking/EventId/<n>, venue); no load-more exists, the list is complete. Booking pages only repeat title/date/venue and start a booking flow that asks members to log in, so no fee is public. Events with an /Our-Events/<slug> info page (left navigation) get a description; its Programme link is a Cvent summary read once via fetch_validated for start time, full venue name and city. The next Annual Scientific Meeting (2027, ICC Wales) is announced only as a home-page banner sentence and is added from it.

concerns: Members' fees behind login: every booking page says 'Notice to members: please log in before making any bookings' and starts a postback booking flow (not followed; no login attempted). Cvent registration is a script app with no fee text in the HTML. pricing_tiers [] on all 4 rows: checked the booking page, the /Our-Events info pages (CholeSafe's is a flyer image, which I viewed: date/venue only, 'registration details to follow', no fee), and the Cvent summary hop.

Recon said load-more: not true. The list table holds all 3 upcoming events (Oct 2026 - Mar 2027 window); the Regional Meetings page lists no dated events. The 2026 ASM (Harrogate, 23-25 Sep) is past and not emitted.

ASM 2027 comes from one banner sentence on the home page (under a stale 'AUGIS ASM 2026' heading); the row uses #asm-2027 on the home URL until the society publishes an event page. City is not stated (ICC Wales); region 'Wales' is derived from the venue name.

Yorkshire Regional Meeting: only date and venue (LNER Community Stadium) are published; city not stated, region England inferred from 'Yorkshire'. External hop: the Cvent summary only (host checked with urlparse().hostname, check_url_safe + fetch_validated, 1 request per event with a Programme link).

No AI restriction found for augis.org (robots.txt and terms silent); the extractor makes no LLM calls anyway. specialty 'Surgery (General)' (ASGBI precedent), fixed. Event types are all 'conference' (symposium, one-day meeting, regional meeting): no course/workshop wording on any page.

2026-10-22 audit fix: description picker rejects nav/notice phrases and text under 60 chars (body paragraph, then meta, else None). Only the Palliative Care Symposium has a qualifying paragraph; the other three rows return None from the extractor (the merge step adds nothing but description_hint, which these shells lack). Nav-leak text on them is therefore added downstream (remediator/LLM) from the booking page notice, not by this module.
